$comment: HUD clocks the replay aligner (services/clip/replay_align.py, BD6, D431) can read by OCR as a second check on the audio alignment. Boxes are fractions of the full capture frame (pillarbox included), x0/y0 top-left, x1/y1 bottom-right. Measured by the agent on one frame each of two 2026-11-21 replay passes (spectator HUD with replay controls, and player HUD) (frame kept local, not committed). Status unverified: one recording, one match mode, default replay control layout. slope: +1 when the clock counts up with the replay, -1 when it counts down.
